headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 15, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 23.01% compared to SPY's 11.77%. This performance translates to an average alpha of 11.23%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's returns. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 48.03%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 6.36%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. Outperforming a broad benchmark like SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or macro uncertainty, as it signals resilience in the portfolio's performance. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
